statement: The application shall let a user send and receive plain text instant messages with people on the user's buddy list.
The application shall show which buddies are currently online.
The application shall show, when available, what program or channel a buddy is watching.
The application shall allow users to add and remove buddies.
The application shall update a buddy's presence status in near real time.
The application shall allow users to change their own nickname and reflect that nickname change to other users.
If a contact is blocked, that contact shall no longer be able to message the user.
If a contact is blocked, that contact shall not appear as available in the normal buddy view.
The application shall display a clear visible on-screen notification for incoming messages so the user knows a message has arrived even when not actively in the chat.
Offline messages shall be queued so they can be delivered when the recipient comes back online.
The retention period for queued messages and chat history is not yet decided and must be confirmed with the team.
The team must determine whether users should be able to view older logs from the TV interface.
Chat history should be limited rather than permanent for privacy and storage reasons.
The TV interface should provide at least recent conversation history for viewing.
Users should have some control over their presence visibility and sharing settings.
Users should be able to appear offline.
Users should be able to hide what they are watching from other users.
